metadata.candidate_selection_adaptation: After LOWVOL36 failed only the frozen history-coverage gate, select the paper's separately reported 52-week weekly-return robustness specification as a new fully penalized trial. LOWVOL36 remains unchanged and rejected.
metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 22-session label, at least 0.95 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20, Amihud20HistoricalProxy, and every frozen same-provider candidate through v2.9
metadata.provider_price_contract: The pinned investment_data Qlib Provider supplies adjusted close values. Weekly returns are calculated directly from those normalized close series; factor is not multiplied into close a second time.
metadata.formation_policy: For every target calendar month, use the last 53 consecutive complete W-FRI week-end adjusted closes whose week ends before the target month to form 52 weekly returns. Compute their sample standard deviation with 52 required observations, negate it, and hold that score constant throughout the target month. Partial target-boundary weeks are excluded.
metadata.holding_policy: Use the paper-supported monthly horizon: a 22-session forward label, Top 50, n_drop=1, and a 21-session minimum holding period. Do not alter the sign, 52-week formation window, observation floor, label, validation segment, or execution contract after viewing results.
metadata.paper_definition: Blitz, Hanauer, and van Vliet report a robustness VOL factor formed from past 52-week volatility with annualized alpha 10.1% and t-value 3.87. Their base 36-month monthly-return sort also shows a positive and significant low-volatility long portfolio alpha.
metadata.paper_proxy_difference: The robustness table reports a beta-neutral long-short VOL factor and does not fully specify week-boundary handling. QuantaAlpha uses 52 consecutive complete W-FRI adjusted-close returns, point-in-time CSI300 members, a monthly constant long-only Top50 signal, and next-session-open execution. This is LowVol52W-CSI300-LongOnly-Proxy, not a paper replication or a profit guarantee.

f7d3a0874fe65303.factor_description: Negative sample standard deviation of the preceding 52 complete weekly adjusted-close returns, held constant throughout the target month. Higher scores identify lower-volatility stocks.
f7d3a0874fe65303.factor_formulation: LowVol52W(t) = -StdDev(r_w for the last 52 complete W-FRI weeks ending before month t), where r_w=C_w/C_(w-1)-1 and all 52 consecutive weekly returns are required

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, stocks with lower volatility over the preceding 52 complete weeks earn higher next-month risk-adjusted returns because leverage constraints and speculative preference can overprice high-risk stocks.

feedback.reason: The sole candidate, operator implementation, negative direction, 52-week formation window, observation floor, period, label, admission gates, and execution contract were frozen before its factor values, RankIC, forward returns, cache, or strategy result were produced.

consistency_check.reason: The expression negates the paper-supported 52-week volatility specification so the long-only rank favors low-volatility stocks; only complete W-FRI weeks ending before the target month are used, preventing target-month leakage.
